pairs.why: A hangs from a looped rope like the real feeder and has the same chunky orange roof and open tray, while B's metal ring bracket and bolt details look less like the real card.
A has the real card's layout, with the door opening on the right, the vents and a front lock, but its metal hinges are a little more literal than the soft plastic of the real locker.
A is built like a real calculator with printed digits and operator keys like the real card, while B's blank keys don't read as a working object.
A has the simpler, chunkier hull and softer finish of the real ship, while B is busier with ladders, rigging and spray, though both are close.
A matches the real cap's soft white crown, its proportions and its matte-satin finish, while B is glossier, more toy-like and has an oversized badge.
A's slimmer shaft and sharper flared flukes are closer to the real anchor's shape, while B has bulkier ball-ended stock arms, though the two finishes are similar.
A's simple stump stools and slightly worn stone are closer to the real chess table, while B's turned, pawn-like stools and cleaner finish look more stylized.
A has labeled keys and a calculator build like the real card, while B's grid of blank keys reads as a generic toy.
